case.title: Design: a taken New Matrix name shows in the banner
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
case.custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Matrix.
  3. Type matrix A's name.
  4. Click Create Matrix.
case.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • The New Matrix page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name shows.

Step 4:

  • The banner reads "Save is blocked" and "A matrix called" matrix A's name "already exists.", with no error under the name field, as in picture 3.25.
